units.source_text: 大概过了一个星期，我偶然听医生查喀说起一件奇闻。

en.t: About a week later, I happened to hear Doctor Chaka tell of a strange incident.
Rumor had it that Tock's house was haunted.

units.source_text: 那会儿，原来那只雌河童不知道去哪了，托喀的家变成了摄影工作室。

en.t: By then, the female kappa who had lived there had gone off somewhere, and Tock's house had become a photography studio.

units.source_text: 听查喀说，每当有顾客来这间工作室拍照，后面总是隐约出现托喀的影子。

en.t: According to Chaka, whenever customers came to this studio to have their photographs taken, Tock's shadow would always appear faintly behind them.

units.source_text: 毫无疑问，查喀是个唯物主义者，不相信死后有幽灵。

en.t: There was no doubt that Chaka was a materialist, and he did not believe in ghosts after death.

units.source_text: 他说这件事的时候，也不怀好意的笑着，说：“这么说来灵魂这个东西也是有物质的存在哩。”

en.t: When he spoke about it, he smiled maliciously and said, "In that case, the soul must also have a material existence."

units.source_text: 我跟查喀想法一样，都不相信有幽灵。

en.t: I thought the same way as Chaka, and neither of us believed in ghosts.

units.source_text: 但是我对诗人托喀怀有好感，于是到书店买了一批刊有托喀的幽灵的照片和刊有相关新闻的报刊。

en.t: But I felt warmly toward the poet Tock, so I went to a bookstore and bought a stack of newspapers and magazines carrying photographs of Tock's ghost and related reports.

units.source_text: 果不其然，在这些照片上，在大大小小的雌雄河童身后，能够模模糊糊辨认出一只像是托喀的河童。

en.t: Sure enough, in these photographs, behind male and female kappa of all sizes, one could faintly make out a kappa that looked like Tock.

units.source_text: 照片上出现的托喀的幽灵倒不是最让我吃惊的，而是灵学会提供的相关报告。

en.t: What surprised me most was not Tock's ghost appearing in the photographs, but the related report provided by the Society for Psychic Studies.

units.source_text: 我把报告详细的翻译出来了，把内容梗概写在下面。

en.t: I translated the report in detail and have written a summary of its contents below.

units.source_text: 括号里的是我自己加的注释。

en.t: The notes in parentheses are comments I added myself.
